title: mail/get: fragile not-found detection via Debug string matching
description: In crates/mail/src/email/get.rs fetch_email(), when get_raw() returns Err(e), the code does format\!("{e:?}") and checks if the string contains 'NotFound' or 'not found'. This is fragile: a change to IpfsWriteError's Debug impl or a new error variant containing those words would silently misclassify real errors as 'not found'. Fix: match on IpfsWriteError::NotFound(_) directly.
